product_purpose: From canonical Home, complete at most three confirmed free Hero Duel–Survival entry/exit cycles per reset. Save the first five current eligible defense heroes; retain a complete valid independent attack lineup and fill only missing eligible slots; exit each loaded battle and Flee without requiring a win.

transition_contracts.permitted_input: current-frame-bound Arena navigation from canonical Home
postconditions: the current Arena screen is positively recognized
no other PvP mode or event is selected

transition_contracts.permitted_input: select the exact current Hero Duel–Survival event
postconditions: current event identity and active state are bound
Hero Duel–Glory is not treated as the same event
Emergency Details exclusions are read from the current event

transition_contracts.permitted_input: dismiss only the current recognized informational Emergency Details popup
postconditions: current event identity remains Hero Duel–Survival
the event's prohibited heroes remain bound as current exclusions

transition_contracts.permitted_input: select the first five eligible displayed defense heroes and use Save Form when a save is required
postconditions: all five slots contain the first five currently eligible heroes, skipping current exclusions
the Save Form acknowledgement is positively observed before opponents are used
the exact active Survival overview is recognized
available free entries and current pass balance are read

transition_contracts.permitted_input: use current Challenge and only Challenge Now if the free-path upsell is shown; never Activate
postconditions: a current listed opponent with an explicit Free control is recognized
no premium, purchase, refresh, or paid entry control is used

transition_contracts.permitted_input: select one currently listed opponent with an explicit Free control
postconditions: the selected opponent remains bound to the current event and free allowance
the independent attack lineup is shown

transition_contracts.permitted_input: fill only missing attack slots from the first five current eligible heroes and leave a complete valid lineup unchanged
postconditions: the attack formation independently contains five current eligible heroes
a complete valid attack formation is not cleared or needlessly replaced

transition_contracts.permitted_input: Challenge the selected listed opponent only with current exact zero-cost Free evidence
postconditions: event identity, reset, free allowance, pass balance, and cycle ordinal are bound
a positively recognized loaded Wave 1/1 battle is required
entry transport alone is not a confirmed cycle

transition_contracts.permitted_input: use the recognized normal Exit control immediately after the loaded battle is observed
postconditions: no combat action or battle loop occurs
the current Flee warning and Flee control are recognized

transition_contracts.permitted_input: select Flee on the current warning and never Fight
postconditions: a current loss/result screen is recognized
the current event, reset, cycle ordinal, and participation successor remain bound

transition_contracts.permitted_input: continue the current loss result without selecting Buy Now or another reward
postconditions: current participation/attempt evidence positively confirms this entry/exit cycle
confirmed cycle progress is durably reconciled before another entry
the current event positively shows no eligible free entries
no paid entry or attempt refresh is substituted

transition_contracts.permitted_input: use only route-owned source-bound return navigation to canonical Home
postconditions: canonical Home is positively recognized
no identical unresolved input is retried

cost_quantity_requirements.notes: Each entry is one exact current Free action costing zero resources; confirm at most three participation cycles per reset. An unknown or nonzero cost is prohibited.

cooldown_deferred_behavior: Defer when the current event has no eligible free entry, preserve confirmed cycle proofs, and stop at three confirmed cycles per reset; never substitute paid entry or another event.
bounded_recovery_behavior: Stop on unknown or changed event, event exclusions, free cost, opponent, allowance, lineup, battle, Exit/Flee/result, participation successor, or Home. Never retry an uncertain entry; preserve every confirmed ordinal and settle its effect before another cycle.
evidence_requirements: A current source-bound native acceptance must demonstrate defense Save Form, independent attack lineup, exact free cost, loaded battle Exit/Flee, loss continuation, and participation successor.
Acceptance must prove at most three confirmed cycle ordinals per reset or stop when current free entries are exhausted, with attempt-versus-confirmed counts durably reconciled.
Current end-to-end replay/native evidence for event identity and canonical Home is missing; the observed single investigation cycle is not three-cycle route acceptance.

required_evidence: hash-bound native route capture/replay covering a confirmed entry/flee/result successor
source-bound evidence for first-five-eligible defense and independent attack formation behavior
reset-scoped three-cycle quota proof or positive event-exhaustion evidence
attempt-versus-confirmed effect reconciliation and canonical Home

replay_fixture_requirements.notes: A synthetic policy fixture or the one prior investigation cycle does not prove the bounded route's three confirmed cycles, reset persistence, or event exhaustion.

unsupported_or_manual_only_states: fewer than five eligible defense heroes
